## Gift Card Images Settings

Option | Type |	Default |Description
-------|------|---------|-----------
giftSlider | string | '[data-role=gift-slider]'| Container selector for module elements
mainImageGallery | string | '[data-gallery-role=gallery]'| Container selector with product galleri
eventElement | string | '[data-role=gift-link]'| Element selector for tracking the selected image
productForm | string | '#product_addtocart_form'| Product form selector
inputGift | string | 'ewave_giftcard_image' | Name Card Image input
clearGallery | boolean | true | Delete previously selected images from the gallery
dataImages | array | [] | Image data
enableSlider | boolean | true | Enable / Disable slider for Gift Card Images
slickSettings| object | {} | Settings for the slider. http://kenwheeler.github.io/slick/
